module counter_08 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [7:0] incr,
  output [7:0] accum,
  output overflow
);

  reg [7:0] accum_reg;
  reg overflow_reg;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      accum_reg <= 8'd0;
      overflow_reg <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      // Check for overflow before updating accumulator
      if ((incr[7] == 1'b0) && (accum_reg[7] == 1'b1)) begin
        // Positive increment to negative value - might cause overflow
        if (accum_reg >= (8'd255 - incr)) begin
          accum_reg <= 8'd255;  // Saturate to maximum positive value
          overflow_reg <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
          accum_reg <= accum_reg + incr;
          overflow_reg <= 1'b0;
        end
      end else if ((incr[7] == 1'b1) && (accum_reg[7] == 1'b0)) begin
        // Negative increment to positive value - might cause overflow
        if (accum_reg <= (8'd0 - incr)) begin
          accum_reg <= 8'd0;    // Saturate to minimum value
          overflow_reg <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
          accum_reg <= accum_reg + incr;
          overflow_reg <= 1'b0;
        end
      end else begin
        // No overflow condition, normal addition
        accum_reg <= accum_reg + incr;
        overflow_reg <= 1'b0;
      end
    end
  end

  assign accum = accum_reg;
  assign overflow = overflow_reg;

endmodule
